sloka: यानि स्म रमणीयानि तया सह भवन्ति मे ।तानि एव अरमणीयानि जायन्ते मे तया विना ॥४-१-७०॥
transliteration: yāni sma ramaṇīyāni tayā saha bhavanti me ।tāni eva aramaṇīyāni jāyante me tayā vinā ॥4-1-70॥

translations.english: 'Seeing the delicate petals around the lotus buds that look like beautiful eyelids of Sita, my eyes crave for them O Lakshmana
